price_policy: Ordinary admission is the fallback. Verified individual age tariffs are applied separately for each visit date; missing age or an unverified band uses the ordinary tariff with an explicit warning. Food costs cover the same explicit order per participant, including children; child portions are not modeled. Proof-dependent, family, birthday and online promotions are excluded.
